name: NATURAL LAND MAP
purpose: Persistent natural-land archive preserving geostructural information as both spatial data and narrative substrate.
archive_rule: Do not flatten the land into decorative description. Preserve the underlying structural relationships so the map remains reconstructible.
narrative_rule: Coordinates may be encountered as places. Encounters may append memory and consequence without destroying the underlying geostructure.
continuity: CONCRETE COORDINATE -> NATURAL STRUCTURE -> ENCOUNTER -> MEMORY -> MAP HISTORY
